data.narrative:
ForSight Robotics is a Series B biotech company founded by Daniel Glozman (CEO), Joseph Nathan (President/CMO), and Moshe Shoham (Chief Scientist), having raised $195M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 8 private and 3 public companies in the Biotech & Health sector, including Series C comparables Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B), Chai Discovery ($3.8B), and New Limit ($3.1B).

Two valuation methods were applicable. Stage-Progression anchors to the $195M total raised and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $370M. Peer-Median uses the median valuation of the three same-sector adjacent-stage comparables at $3.8B, though the range spans $3.1B to $10.3B. Public-Comp Anchoring via P/S multiples (sector median 8.1x across RXRX, TEM, and ONT.L) could not be applied—target revenue remains undisclosed, typical for private companies.

The triangulated analysis across two methods supports a valuation range of $315M (low) to $4.4B (high), with a median of $2.1B. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around stage-comparable comparability; peer multiples vary substantially depending on clinical stage, technology differentiation, and capital efficiency. Stage-Progression alone suggests conservative positioning near the range floor, while peer-median benchmarking anchors the midpoint. Key uncertainties include pre-revenue status, clinical readiness relative to Series C peers, and whether robotics differentiation commands premium or discount to sector norms.
